provenance.details: The remediation work here strengthens the learner, teacher, standards, and provenance surfaces without claiming that the underlying runtime has been rewritten inside evo-edu.org.
lineage: Public evo-edu route: Digital Evolution Lab
Educational lineage: Avida-ED digital evolution environment
limits: The runtime remains the legacy Avida-ED environment and is currently outside the direct API-remediation tranche.
The route is strongest when paired with explicit experimental framing rather than free exploration alone.
The environment is useful for discussing mutation, selection, adaptation, and contingency, but it should not be over-read as a full model of biological evolution.
